summary: Delegated service principal claim dropped during Okta re-auth, blocking devtools cluster access
description:
Issue summary: After an Okta re-auth (triggered by mandatory MFA rotation) several internal service principals used by devtools lost delegated role/group claims in tokens issued by the SSO proxy. Impact: engineers and CI jobs attempting to access the devtools internal cluster recieved 403s and could not run deployments or fetch secrets. This appears limited to delegated service principals (svc- prefix) that had been provisioned via SCIM and rely on delegated groups claim mapping.

Observed behavior: On re-auth, SSO proxy issues a token that is missing the 'delegated_groups' and 'roles' attributes. Expected behavior: re-auth should preserve service principal attributes or rehydrate them from SCIM so RBAC continues to function.

Related artifacts: Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.internal.redwood/boards/auth-proxy-errors, slack thread: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C01234/support-auth, confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/Auth-Proxy-Reauth
impact: All engineers using svc-devtools / CI runners in us-west could not access devtools cluster for ~2 hours. Blocked deploys and secret fetches for ~60 pipelines. No customer-facing service outage, internal developer productivity impact only.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use an Okta-backed service principal (svc-devtools) provisioned via SCIM with delegated groups mapping.
2) Force an Okta re-auth by revoking session or prompting MFA rotation for the principal, or wait for scheduled device MFA rotation window.
3) Perform kubectl against devtools cluster via support-identity proxy. Observe 403 with missing-group error.
4) Inspect proxy token issuance logs for the principal: missing delegated_groups / roles attributes in the returned token.
logs: Mar 10 09:12:07 auth-proxy[pid:3211]: INFO reauth for principal=svc-devtools-07; session_id=stg-xx; source=okta; MFA=required
Mar 10 09:12:08 auth-proxy[pid:3211]: WARN attribute mapping: delegated_groups absent for principal=svc-devtools-07; scim_lookup=false
Mar 10 09:12:09 rbac-checker[pid:887]: ERROR access denied: missing delegated_groups claim; principal=svc-devtools-07; resource=k8s:devtools:secrets
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Okta session cookie rotation during MFA enforcement triggers a fast-path in the auth-proxy that uses the existing session cache but does not trigger SCIM rehydration for service principals.

Hypothesis 2: A config change in auth-proxy (rollout 2026-03-08) introduced a short-circuit to reduce latency for human user reauths but accidentally skips delegated-attribute merge for non-interactive principals.
Checked Okta system logs: re-auth event shows MFA challenge completed for svc-devtools token; no SCIM PATCH events produced.
Auth-proxy config at /etc/auth-proxy/config.yaml shows 'rehydrate_on_reauth: false' in canary config applied on 2026-03-08 (confirmed via PR #4892).
Reproduced in staging by toggling rehydrate_on_reauth=false; observed identical missing claims. With rehydrate_on_reauth=true claims persisted.
Correlation: incidents start time aligns with canary rollout window to us-west nodes 2026-03-08 22:00 UTC.
comments: Aisha Patel (2026-03-10 09:35): Noticed multiple engineers reporting 403s to devtools cluster. Initial lookpoints: changes pushed to auth-proxy last week; opening ticket to triage. Tagged SRE and identity teams.

Marcus Liu (SRE) (2026-03-10 10:02): Investigating. Pulled auth-proxy logs and confirmed missing delegated_groups on token issuance. Marking likely regression from recent canary. Temporarily routed traffic away from updated nodes as mitigation.
Jane Roberts (DevTools) (2026-03-10 10:40): Confirmed CI runners affected; queued runs failed to fetch secrets. Workaround request: is there a way to rehydrate claims without reprovisioning?

Marcus Liu (SRE) (2026-03-10 11:15): Applied emergency config change: set rehydrate_on_reauth=true on us-west auth-proxy nodes. Observed token issuance includes delegated_groups again. Rolling restart completed. Monitoring for 30m.

Marcus Liu (2026-03-12 14:20): Root cause identified: PR #4892 introduced reauth fast-path to optimize latency for interactive users; conditionals omitted service-principal branch. PR #4901 contains the fix to preserve delegated attributes on reauth. Deployed to prod us-west at 2026-03-12 13:05 UTC.
Aisha Patel (2026-03-12 15:00): Verified with affected engineers: CI and manual access restored. Closing impact window and documenting follow-ups.
resolution: Applied fix in auth-proxy (PR #4901) to ensure rehydration of delegated attributes on re-auth for service principals. Emergency config rollback (rehydrate_on_reauth=true) used as short-term mitigation while fix rolled out. Post-deploy verification completed: tokens issued include delegated_groups and roles; RBAC checks succeed. Follow-ups: 1) add unit + e2e tests covering service-principal reauth path (owner: identity team). 2) Update runbook to include 'rehydrate_on_reauth' check and emergency steps. 3) Add an alert on high rate of 'missing delegated_groups' errors to the auth-proxy Grafana dashboard.
